usageNotes: Returns the WebAuthn (FIDO2) relying-party configuration currently active in Proxmox Datacenter Manager — specifically the RP ID, RP name, origin, and subdomain policy. Call this before enrolling hardware keys or troubleshooting failed WebAuthn assertions to confirm the relying-party settings match the URL users actually browse to. Any authenticated user or API token may call it; no elevated privilege is required.

examples.summary: Fetch the current WebAuthn relying-party config

tips: The `id` field is the Relying Party ID (domain only, no scheme/port). It must exactly match the eTLD+1 of the URL users browse — a mismatch causes every WebAuthn assertion to fail.
If `origin` is omitted, PDM derives it automatically; set it explicitly when your PDM instance is behind a reverse proxy or load balancer with a different hostname.
`allow-subdomains: true` (the default) lets credentials registered on `pdm.example.com` authenticate on `other.example.com` — disable it in strict single-host deployments.
Changing `id` or `rp` invalidates all existing registered hardware keys; warn users before modifying those fields via the corresponding PUT/POST endpoint.
